summary: Approved Gradium startup grants provide 54M credits worth over $2,000 through six months of the M plan, covering TTS, STT and voice cloning APIs plus technical support. Eligibility requires a Seed or Series A round, fewer than 25 employees, and voice as a core product component with a clear monetization strategy; one-off projects are not eligible. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis with an aim to respond in two to three business days. Eligibility needs confirmation: the program FAQ requires Seed or Series A, while the current application form also offers Pre-Seed. Do not assume that a Pre-Seed form option guarantees eligibility. The form requires contact/company details, employee count, funding stage, amount raised and a project description; website and deck/demo attachments are optional.
claim_steps: Confirm your startup has raised Seed or Series A, has fewer than 25 employees, and has voice as a core product component with a clear monetization strategy; one-off projects do not qualify.
Pre-Seed applicants: ask Gradium to confirm eligibility. The current form offers Pre-Seed, but the program FAQ states Seed or Series A; the conflict is unresolved.

Complete the official application at gradium.ai/startups/apply with contact/company details, employee count, funding stage, amount raised and a project description. Website and deck/demo attachments are optional.
Wait for rolling review; Gradium aims to respond within two to three business days.
If accepted, activate the six-month M plan grant. When credits run out, continuing requires subscribing to a standard plan.
